Working Model Required

Monday–Friday, Eastern business hours.
Onsite presence required one day per week.
Flexibility required for additional onsite days for meetings or business needs, as planned and scheduled.
Remote workdays require a stable, secure, quiet, and compliant workstation using MGB-provided equipment.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic is growing fast, and our SOX program needs to keep up. Many of the controls that matter for financial reporting run on engineering systems: who can access production and financial systems, how code changes are reviewed and deployed, and how usage is metered and billed.

We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to own the technology side of our SOX program. You'll work across engineering, security, GRC, Finance, and Internal Audit to design and run IT controls, drive gaps to closure, and make compliance lighter for engineering teams. You’ll also use Claude to automate evidence collection and control testing, so the program scales without more manual work.

Responsibilities

Own the technology side of the SOX program end-to-end, from planning and control design through evidence, testing, remediation, and year-end reporting
Work with engineering teams to design and roll out IT general controls and IT application controls
Work with engineering teams to build Claude-based workflows, tools, and dashboards to automate evidence collection, control testing, and monitoring that warns engineering teams about compliance issues before an audit finds them
Lead large SOX projects, such as bringing new systems into scope, with clear success criteria, dependencies, and delivery dates
Turn control requirements into concrete engineering work with clear scope, owners, and deadlines, and a design that fits how our teams already build and ship
Build processes to evaluate new products, systems, and major engineering changes for SOX impact before they ship, so the right controls are in place from the start
Build strong working relationships with engineering control owners, help them understand what their controls require, and support them in producing evidence for auditor requests
Investigate control failures down to root cause, and drive engineering teams to fix them in time for the fix to be tested
Help keep an up-to-date list of the systems, apps, and infrastructure in SOX scope, with an owner named for each control
Track system migrations and scope changes, and make sure controls are updated as systems move
Build metrics and dashboards on control health, open findings, and remediation progress
Give regular updates on program status, risks, and remediation to technical leadership
Keep improving the program: simplify control processes, remove manual steps, and raise the share of controls that run cleanly

You may be a good fit if you

Have 7+ years of experience in technical program management, IT audit, or technology compliance, with a focus on SOX and IT general controls
Have run or supported a SOX program at a public or pre-IPO company
Have used automation or AI tools to make compliance work faster and more reliable
Know IT general controls and IT application controls in depth, including access management, change management, and application controls, and how they support financial reporting
Have worked closely with external auditors
Understand cloud infrastructure and engineering workflows, such as code review, CI/CD, and cloud access, well enough to work through a control design with an engineer
Can explain technical risks and control gaps clearly to executives and other non-technical audiences
Are comfortable driving outcomes across engineering, finance, and audit teams that don't report to you

Strong candidates may also have

A background in software, systems, or security engineering
Hands-on experience building with Claude Code or other AI tools
Experience with automated controls in revenue or order-to-cash systems, such as billing and usage metering
Experience with financial systems such as ERP and billing platforms, and the controls around them
Experience building or rebuilding a SOX program at a fast-growing company
Familiarity with other security and IT frameworks, such as NIST or ISO 27001

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$290,000—$365,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. The Cybersecurity Manager (High-Tech Manufacturing & Semiconductors) leads the strategic alignment, implementation, and management of the organization's information and operational security frameworks. This role bridges the gap between complex enterprise risk strategies and practical technical engineering controls. Operating in a high-value manufacturing environment, this manager is primarily responsible for Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), while possessing the technical fluency required to collaborate effectively with IT, Operational Technology (OT), and engineering teams. The core mission is to protect proprietary intellectual property (IP), secure advanced fabrication supply chains, ensure operational uptime, and maintain audit readiness against global regulatory standards.

Responsibilities

Core Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Responsibilities
Framework Alignment: Define, execute, and mature information security policies mapped explicitly to ISO/IEC 27001, NIST SP 800-53, and semiconductor industry specifications (e.g., SEMI cybersecurity standards).
Risk Management & Audits: Lead formal risk assessments across corporate networks. Manage internal and external audits, compiling risk registers and mapping mitigation paths.
Third-Party Supply Chain Security: Establish comprehensive vendor assessment criteria to evaluate and continually audit external component suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and outsourced service providers.
Regulatory Compliance: Coordinate and ensure enterprise compliance with international regulations relevant to manufacturing data flows, including GDPR, export control constraints, and client-specific data non-disclosure mandates.

Architectural Alignment: Review technical designs for Identity & Access Management (IAM), network zoning/micro-segmentation, and zero-trust remote access architecture to ensure strict compliance with internal security baselines.
Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Collaborate with security operations and IT engineering to translate vulnerability scan results and penetration testing findings into prioritized, risk-based remediation plans for production-critical servers and workstations.

Unsere Motivation sind Softwarelösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag unserer Kund*innen wirklich erleichtern und sie erfolgreicher machen. Das schaffen wir mit einem einzigartigen Team, Leidenschaft für Technologien, Mut für ausgefallene Wege und sehr viel Herzlichkeit, Ambition und Spaß bei der Arbeit.
Dein Team

Wir im internen IT-Team sorgen dafür, dass alle technischen Abläufe reibungslos funktionieren – von Hardware, Software und Netzwerken über zentrale Dienste wie Active Directory bis hin zu modernen Cloud-Services. Wir stellen die sichere und zuverlässige IT-Infrastruktur für alle Mitarbeitenden bereit, entwickeln Lösungen für effizientes Arbeiten und sind zentrale Anlaufstelle bei Fragen rund um IT und Informationssicherheit. Mit einem klaren Fokus auf Stabilität, Sicherheit und Innovation schaffen wir die Basis für produktives Arbeiten und den Schutz unserer Unternehmensinformationen.

Aufgaben

Informationssicherheit ist für dich kein Pflichtprogramm, sondern ein Thema, für das du brennst. Du kennst die wachsenden Herausforderungen, bewegst dich sicher zwischen Risiko, Governance und Technik und willst Security im Unternehmen wirksam voranbringen.
Du betreibst und entwickelst unser Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystem (ISMS) weiter – von Policies und Risikomanagement bis Awareness und Reporting.
Du koordinierst ISO-27001-/TISAX-Audits, externe Reviews und Zertifizierungen und begleitest die Bearbeitung der Findings.
Du koordinierst Security Assessments für Lieferanten, Services, Tools, AI Use Cases und Kundenanforderungen.
Du bringst bereichsübergreifende Security-Initiativen voran, übersetzt Risiken in konkrete Maßnahmen und behältst deren Umsetzung im Blick.
Du verbindest unser Information Security Governance Board mit den Business Units, Corporate Functions, technischen Expert*innen und externen Partnern; bei Blockern sorgst du für Klarheit und Eskalation.

Profil

Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Informationssicherheit mit und kennst dich fundiert mit Informationssicherheitsmanagement, ISO 27001 und Security Governance aus.
Ein gutes technisches Security-Verständnis zeichnet dich aus – insbesondere in den Bereichen Cloud, AI, Endpoint und Softwareentwicklung.
Du hast Erfahrung im Risiko-, Audit-, Maßnahmen- und Projektmanagement.
Teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit liegt dir: Du kommunizierst klar, koordinierst souverän und bleibst bei der Nachverfolgung verbindlich.
Du kannst technische, regulatorische und Management-Perspektiven zusammenbringen und findest pragmatische Lösungen.
Sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

Wir bieten

Home Office, Workation, Fahrrad-Leasing oder das perfekte Teilzeitmodell für dich. Unsere Benefits begleiten dich in deinem Arbeitsalltag bei itdesign und bieten dir vieles, was auch nach Feierabend Spaß macht und dein Leben verschönert.

Wir bereiten alles für deinen Start bei itdesign vor und geben dir alles an die Hand, damit du deine Aufgaben und Kolleg*innen kennenlernen kannst. Dabei helfen dir dein*e Mentor*in, dein individueller Einarbeitungsplan, Kennenlerngespräche und Schnupperpraktika.
Flexibel

As a market maker, Virtu provides deep liquidity that helps to create more efficient markets around the world. Our market structure expertise, broad diversification, and execution technology enables us to provide competitive bids and offers in over 19,000 securities, at over 235 venues, in 36 countries worldwide.

THE ROLE

Our Trading Operations team is a multi-faceted group whose roles and responsibilities directly support the foundation of trading at Virtu. This team provides the operational efficiency that is central to our success in trading; they manage and optimize the logistics, mechanics and back office workflows that keep Virtu best-in-class.

We are looking to hire an Analyst who will be responsible for managing the clearance, settlement, and reconciliation of all trades and positions for the firm. jobs.description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

We're looking for a high-energy, execution-focused Analyst to join our Global Patient Care team and power the operations that support 14 countries. This isn't just about monitoring queues; it's about being the engine behind a healthy Salesforce ecosystem and the pioneer of our AI-driven automation strategy. You will bridge the gap between technical infrastructure and local impact, ensuring our global operations are data-backed, automated, and running at peak performance. If you thrive in a high-visibility environment where your work ships daily and directly empowers teams worldwide, we want to talk to you.

How will you make an impact?

Salesforce & Patient Support Operations

Monitor the health of our global Salesforce case operations (routing, queues, case-reason taxonomy) and catch problems before they affect patients or local teams.
Work closely with our regional managers (LATAM & Spain, Europe) to understand each market's problems, challenges and improvement opportunities.
Turn what you find into clear, prioritized requests (problem, evidence, impact), so we can fix it ourselves or take it to the global Salesforce team. Over time, you'll handle that conversation with Salesforce directly.
Turn recurring operational issues into documented processes that work across markets while respecting each country's local needs.

AI & Automation

Track how our AI case-reply tools and automations are performing, flag regressions and suggest improvements backed by data.
Help local teams adopt the automations we build with the Salesforce team, and gather their feedback on what works and what doesn't.

Analysis & Critical Thinking

Use AI tools (Claude with our data connectors, Data Sage) and SQL to answer operational questions. What matters most is knowing which questions to ask and how to read the answers.
Identify, analyze and prioritize: turn data into a clear recommendation and defend it, and challenge ours when you think we're missing something.
Maintain our existing Superset dashboards and build simple ones when your own analysis needs them.

Qualifications

What will help you thrive?

2-5 years of experience in Operations, Strategy Ops, Sales Ops, RevOps, or Data Analysis;
Understanding of product and business dynamics;
Technical Prowess: You have working SQL skills (joins/aggregations) and can navigate Salesforce Service Cloud and Superset (or similar BI tools).
Global Communicator: Your English is sharp (written and spoken), and you can distill complex analysis into structured, persuasive business cases.
Bias to Action: You are a closer. You tackle small tasks the same day and have the grit to drive large initiatives to the finish line.
Bonus Points: You bring experience in support operations or speak Spanish, adding even more value to our multi-country coordination.

What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat
– A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview
– A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Flavia Soccol and André Mosko as your potential managers in this role .
Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣ Business Case –
A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

4️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits –
No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks –
Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth –
We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team –
Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You –
Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results –
we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner –
take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean –
smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest –
openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious –
growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

jobs.title: Founding Strategy and Operations Analyst role - London
jobs.description:
Building a More Resilient World

When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.

We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.

And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done."

We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join.

The Role

Handling claims at scale requires a strong operational foundation. As our Founding Strategy & Operations Analyst, you’ll help build the operational capability that lets ClaimSorted deliver market-leading claims handling while running efficiently as we grow. You’ll work with data to find problems, then take on the projects that fix them, increasing the speed and volume of operational change across the company. As part of this role you will:

Design and implement efficient claims processes and procedures, and make sure they are adopted and hold up as the team grows.
Build and manage the KPIs and metrics we use to handle claims and run the organisation as efficiently as possible.
Analyse operational data to understand problems, surface insights, and turn them into practical solutions.
Take ownership of small projects and support complex cross-functional initiatives, from scoping through to delivery.
Work with teams across the company to make operational changes land quickly.

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We’re a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in consulting, data or analytics, or operations at a startup, tech firm or consultancy
Demonstrated experience working with data to provide insights, understand problems and deliver effective solutions
Demonstrated experience implementing solutions and running small projects or changes
Strong written and spoken communication, with a proven ability to work cross-functionally
A generalist mindset: comfortable picking up whatever problem matters most and moving quickly
Insurance or claims experience is a plus, but not required

Our Values

Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimise for momentum.
Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.
Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.
Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for ‘good enough.’
Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

Compensation & Benefits

Generous, transparent equity participation
28 days annual leave plus bank holidays
30 days of remote work annually
Private medical insurance
Pension contributions
Company offsites
Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

Job Purpose

Translates business requirements into detailed functional specifications, then delivers, supports, and continuously improves the business applications, automations, and reports used by Subsea Services as part of a shared Business Systems analyst team.

Job Description

Serve as the primary contact for business application requests, managing intake, prioritization, and support backlog.
Design, develop, and maintain low-code solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, and SharePoint.
Develop and manage Power BI reports, data models, dashboards, and reporting governance.
Identify and implement automation and process improvement opportunities to enhance operational efficiency.
Administer application lifecycle management, governance, security, documentation, and environment support.
Support enterprise systems (Salesforce, Parsable, Ignition/MES, S/4HANA) including user access, data integrity, and adoption.
Partner with stakeholders, IT, and data teams to deliver business solutions, reporting, ERP readiness, and data-driven insights.
Lead project coordination, requirements gathering, Agile participation, incident management, user training, and continuous improvement initiatives.

You Are Meant For This Job If

Bachelor’s degree or higher in IT, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field
2+ years of experience in business systems analysis, application development, or data analytics
Working knowledge of business processes in operations, supply chain, manufacturing, or field service environments
Strong knowledge of business principles, current technology advances, and IT capabilities
Strong analytical, critical, and systems thinking
Proficient in SQL and at least one programming language
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and SharePoint

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. Accountable for project financial performance within the approved budget. Monitors, interprets, and communicates project budget, actuals, forecast, and estimate-at-completion information. Escalates significant variances and supports corrective actions.
Ensures project time, expenses, invoices, and financial records are accurately tracked, reviewed, and approved in a timely manner.
Validates initial project scope, assumptions, estimates, deliverables, and acceptance criteria. Manages the change-control process, assesses impacts to scope, schedule, cost, resources, and risk, and determines whether a Change Order or new Statement of Work may be required.

Develops, maintains, adjusts, and communicates project schedules, tasks, milestones, and dependencies in collaboration with the project team, client, subcontractors, and third-party providers.

Contributes to the continuous improvement of project management standards, templates, tools, best practices, and shared knowledge resources.
Communication: Determines and maintains the appropriate project documentation, including schedules, status reports, budget information, quality plans, risk and issue logs, decision records, action items, and closure documentation.

Negotiation: Gathers relevant information and seeks input from Sales or Services leadership when needed. Negotiates project changes involving cost, scope, schedule, effort, or resource commitments within assigned authority.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Partner Ecosystem
new_jobs.description:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

About The Role

Socure’s Partner Ecosystem brings third-party data and decisioning partners into RiskOS. Every partner we onboard has to be integrated cleanly, operated reliably, implemented correctly in customer environments, and understood well enough that our Solutions and Sales teams can put it to work. This role owns the technical side of all of it.

You will be the technical point of accountability for the RiskOS partner ecosystem. You will align with partners on an integration approach. Solutions teams come to you when an implementation doesn't behave. You will define scope, requirements, and priority for the Partner Integration engineering pod. Internal teams come to you to understand what a partner product actually does and when to use it.

This is not just a coordination or ticket-writing role. You will personally run partner API discovery, write the specs the pod builds from, sit in the middle of live troubleshooting, and own the documentation the rest of the company depends on. You will drive the partner engineering pod's roadmap and execution without managing the engineers directly — technical credibility, clarity, and relationships are how the work gets done here.

It is also a role that will grow. As our partner marketplace takes shape, you will be the technical driver behind it: defining what it takes for a partner product to be integrated and consumed at scale.

What You'll Do

Own partner integrations end to end

Own the program for every new integration: discovery, technical scope, specs, sequencing, and launch readiness — and the pod's roadmap, priorities, and capacity tradeoffs that deliver it.
Establish reusable integration patterns — authentication, data mapping, error handling, retries, fallbacks — so each new partner integration is faster than the last.
Work with Product and Legal/GRC so contractual and compliance constraints shape the design up front rather than surface as rework.

Be the technical counterpart to our partners

Serve as the primary technical contact for partner engineering and solutions teams, from API discovery through release and deprecation cycles.
Evaluate partner APIs, data models, SLAs, and support posture to identify the optimal integration path — and push back where their proposed pattern creates fragility, latency, cost, or compliance risk.
Define what "integration-ready" means for the marketplace — technical requirements, certification, acceptance criteria — and eventually hold that bar with partners who build into our platform themselves.

Make partner products succeed in customer environments

Work with pre-sales Solutions to help them understand partner products: what they do, what they require, what they cost, and what they can't do.
Work with post-sales Solutions and Implementation to ensure correct configuration across sandbox and production, and flag workflow designs that will produce poor decisioning outcomes.
Build the enablement material that lets Solutions teams handle routine cases independently.
Own triage and resolution for integration escalations, define monitoring requirements for integration health, and run a recurring audit cadence that produces remediation rather than a list of known issues.

Own documentation and product expertise — and scale it with AI

Own the technical documentation library: integration specs, API references, configuration guides, and troubleshooting runbooks. Treat documentation drift as a defect.
Use AI aggressively to draft specs and documentation — with the judgment to catch hallucinated behavior and verify against source API docs — and build repeatable AI patterns so throughput isn't bound by your calendar.
Develop working expertise in every partner product and act as the internal explainer for Sales, Solutions, Product, and Support.

What You Bring

5+ years in technical program management, technical product management, solutions architecture, solutions engineering, or integration engineering, including direct ownership of external-facing technical work.
Demonstrated ability to drive engineering execution without direct authority. You have owned a team's roadmap and delivery as an individual contributor and made it work through influence and credibility.
Deep, practical fluency with REST APIs, authentication patterns, webhooks, data mapping and normalization, and the failure modes of third-party dependencies. You can read an API doc set and immediately identify what will break in production.
Strong debugging instincts across distributed systems. You are comfortable in logs, traces, and payloads, and can isolate whether a problem is ours, the partner's, or a configuration issue.
Proven ability to work directly with external technical teams — holding a firm technical position, saying no well, and keeping the relationship intact.
Genuine people skills. This role runs on relationships: with partners, with engineers you don't manage, with Solutions teams under customer pressure, and with leadership. Technical strength alone will not carry it.
Exceptional written communication. The specs and documentation you produce are what other teams depend on; writing is a core competency here, not a nice-to-have.
Hands-on experience using AI tools in your actual workflow, with the discipline to verify output rather than trust it. You should be able to describe patterns you've built that made recurring work faster for more people than just yourself.
Comfort moving between a partner architecture discussion, a customer implementation escalation, and an internal enablement session in the same day.

Preferred Qualifications

Background in identity, fraud, risk, KYC/KYB, credit, or adjacent data-provider ecosystems.
Experience integrating and operating many third-party data vendors at scale, including managing vendor API versioning and deprecation.
Experience building or scaling a partner marketplace, app store, developer platform, or partner certification program.
Familiarity with decisioning or workflow orchestration platforms and how data products are composed within them.
Experience working alongside pre-sales and post-sales organizations in B2B enterprise SaaS.
Exposure to the compliance and contractual dimensions of third-party data use: data rights, permissible purpose, retention, and audit requirements.
Prior hands-on engineering background, even if you've since moved into solutions, program, or product work.

new_jobs.title: Global Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

Role Mission

Cognition is growing fast, with teams in San Francisco, New York, London, Berlin, Tokyo, Singapore, Sydney and other cities, and customers that include some of the largest and most security-conscious institutions in the world, including the U.S. government. As a frontier AI company, our people, our offices and the systems we build are attractive targets for nation-state actors, criminals and activists.

The Global Security Manager builds and runs the program that protects Cognition's people, facilities, travel and events worldwide, and the physical and personnel security that supports our Federal division. This is a hands-on, high-trust role: you will set strategy and policy, run day-to-day security operations through a small team and trusted vendors, and be the decision-maker when something goes wrong. You will report to the Chief Security Officer and work closely with Threat Intel & Investigations, Corporate Security, IT, Workplace, People, Legal and the Federal team.

What You'll Accomplish

Risk & Threat Assessment: Monitor geopolitical, environmental, physical and cyber threats globally. Run threat and vulnerability assessments for offices, offsites, events and executive travel destinations, and partner with Threat Intel & Investigations on threats directed at our employees and leadership.
Policy & Strategy Development: Create and enforce security policies, standard operating procedures, emergency response plans and compliance standards worldwide, with a physical security strategy that scales as we open new offices and markets.
Crisis Management & Incident Response: Lead responses to safety threats, travel emergencies and critical incidents, from workplace violence to natural disasters. Own incident command, the mass notification system, and business continuity planning with Legal, People, Workplace and IT, and run post-incident reviews that turn every event into lasting improvements.
Physical Security Operations & Technology: Own access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection and visitor management across our offices. Set security standards for new office build-outs, and integrate physical access with our identity systems alongside Corporate Security and IT.
Team & Vendor Oversight: Manage security personnel, the security operations center (GSOC), and external guard, executive protection and technology vendors. Set performance metrics, manage contracts and budget, and hold partners to a high bar.
Travel & Executive Protection: Oversee global travel risk programs, tracking tools, pre-trip briefings and high-risk journey management. Run the executive protection program for our CEO and leadership team, including advance work, residential security assessments and event security.
Counterintelligence: Build Cognition's counterintelligence program to identify and counter efforts by foreign intelligence services and competitors to gain access to our people, technology and customers, including targeted recruitment, social engineering and elicitation. Provide regular counterintelligence briefings to executives and staff, especially before foreign travel, and partner with Threat Intelligence, the Facility Security Officer and government counterparts on suspected incidents.
Federal Division Security: Interface with our Facility Security Officer, who owns cleared facilities and personnel security, to provide appropriate protections in support of our FedRAMP, ITAR and IL5+ operations, including physical access controls, visitor and foreign-national controls, and insider risk programs.
External Partnerships: Build relationships with local and federal law enforcement, OSAC and peer security teams at other AI labs and technology companies to stay ahead of emerging risks and coordinate during incidents.
Automate with Devin: Use Devin and other AI agents to scale the program: threat and travel monitoring, alert triage, reporting and the operational work that usually requires a large headcount.

Exceptional Candidates Have Demonstrated

Program leadership: 8+ years in corporate or global security, including physical security, executive protection, GSOC operations and travel risk management, ideally at a fast-growing technology company. A background in law enforcement, the military or government is a plus.
Crisis judgment: Experience acting as the senior decision-maker during real incidents, staying calm under pressure, and communicating clearly to executives and employees.
Global, distributed operations: A track record of building or scaling security programs across multiple countries, including selecting and managing third-party vendors and owning a budget.
Industrial security: Familiarity with NISPOM (32 CFR Part 117) and ITAR, and experience working alongside Facility Security Officers to support cleared programs.
Discretion and writing: Strong written communication and the judgment to operate in a confidential, high-trust environment.
Builder mindset: Comfort working in a dynamic environment, moving quickly, and replacing manual processes with tooling and automation.
Background: Prior law enforcement, military, or intelligence experience is required.
Eligibility: US Citizen required, must be clearable to TS/SCI. Previous or current clearance is a plus. Ability to travel and to be available outside business hours during incidents. Certifications such as CPP or PSP are a plus.

Our Commitment

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. new_jobs.title: Project Manager, High-Voltage
new_jobs.description:
Clēnera is a tier-one developer and independent power producer located in Boise, Idaho, and is the U.S. subsidiary of Enlight Renewable Energy (Nasdaq: ENLT). We develop, finance, construct, own, and operate utility-scale solar and energy storage facilities throughout the United States. In its 2025 analysis of solar independent power producers, S&P Global ranked Clēnera as a top ten U.S. owner of planned installations in the next five years. Clēnera has over 1.9 GW of solar and 5.1 GWh of storage in operations or construction, and a development pipeline totaling 17.8 GW of solar and 51.1 GWh of storage across 23 states. Our company culture is at the core of everything we do, so you'll regularly find Caring, Committed, and Courageous individuals who value respectful, cross-functional collaboration with partners internally and externally. With our tremendous portfolio growth, we are increasing our headcount to meet the demands of the business. Are you ready to change the world with us?

ABOUT THE ROLE

The HV Project Manager represents the Owner (IPP) and leads all high-voltage (HV), protection & controls (P&C), SCADA/communications, testing, and commissioning activities for utility-scale solar and energy storage assets. You will own cost, schedule, scope, quality, and risk for the HV build and commissioning phases from pre-functional checks through energization, interconnection testing, COD, and turnover to Operations. The PM functions as the primary interface with utilities, Owner's Engineers, EPCs, testing/commissioning vendors, and internal stakeholders, ensuring systems are safe, compliant, utility-approved, and reliable for long-term operations.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own end-to-end HV and site wide commissioning project planning and control, establishing the WBS, baseline schedule, cash flow forecasts, procurement milestones, and resource plans.
Drive weekly schedule reviews, recovery planning, and critical path management with EPC and site leadership.
Lead HV and site wide commissioning cost management and forecasting, including monthly EAC/EVA updates, change order pricing validation, contingency management, pay application review/approval, and alignment of financial reporting with Project Controls and Finance.
Direct contract administration, ensuring scope clarity, deliverable compliance, and change management discipline; draft, negotiate, and recommend change orders and claims with clear schedule/cost impact analyses.
Coordinate cross-functional execution to ensure design completeness, permitting compliance, interconnection readiness, and QA/QC adherence.
Execute risk management throughout the lifecycle, maintaining the risk register, quantifying impacts, implementing mitigations, and escalating strategic risks to senior leadership with recommended actions.
Drive site safety culture and compliance, integrating HSSE requirements into schedules and work plans and ensuring EPC adherence to safety KPIs and incident reporting.
Manage external stakeholder relationships, including utilities, AHJs, landowners, third party inspectors, and lenders' engineers, ensuring timely reviews, approvals, and alignment on critical path items.
Produce executive ready reports and presentations, summarizing progress, risks, cash flow, and forecasted outcomes for internal leadership and, when applicable, board-level review.
Mentor and guide other members of the project team, delegating workstreams, providing technical direction, and building execution discipline across the project team.
Lead lessons learned and continuous improvement, capturing insights during closeout and feeding back process and contract improvement recommendations to Construction leadership.
Collaborate with individual departments, as well as cross-functionally with other departments within the organization.
Maintain organizational excellence in terms of project timelines and deliverables.
Demonstrates the Clēnera Core Values of Caring, Committed, and Courageous.
Other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Education: Bachelor's degree in construction management, electrical engineering, business, or related field experience.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in HV construction and commissioning project management.
Technology: Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, and an ability to learn company-specific software programs, tools, processes, and machines.
Skills/Attributes:
Strong understanding of schedule and cost controls, including critical path analysis, recovery planning, earned value, EAC forecasting, and cash flow management.
Strong EPC contract administration and negotiation skills, capable of structuring clear change orders, resolving claims, and driving accountability to contractual obligations.
Technical fluency in utility scale HV, construction, including civil works, MV/HV systems, SCADA, protection/controls, energy storage technology and commissioning sequences.
Adept at identifying systemic and emergent risks, quantifying impacts, and implementing mitigation actions that protect COD and budget objectives.
Ability to build trust and effectively coordinate with utilities, AHJs, inspectors, lenders' engineers, and EPC executives to clear critical path issues.
Clear, persuasive communication, producing concise, decision ready reporting for senior leadership and guiding the project team toward shared outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to lead highly effective teams, both internally and externally.
Self-motivated to work through complex problems and competing priorities, including a high level of detail and organization.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.

Travel: 25%

The Senior Project Manager (SPM) will play a critical leadership role in the delivery of a highly complex, ground-up ultra-luxury hotel, resort, and branded residential development on a remote island in the Caribbean. Qualified candidates must demonstrate extensive experience delivering large-scale, ground-up ultra-luxury hospitality projects, along with strong technical construction expertise and experience managing projects in remote or logistically challenging environments.

Candidates based in South Florida are strongly preferred due to the geographic proximity to CMD's current projects.

Under the general direction of the Project Director, the SPM will independently lead day-to-day project execution, including planning, design management, construction oversight, and coordination of multidisciplinary international teams. Acting as an extension of the client's team, the SPM will deliver CMD's Owner's Advisor Services throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment with schedule, budget, quality, and client objectives while upholding CMD's core values of Stewardship, Collaboration, and Professionalism.

Duties & Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Client Relations

Assume primary responsibility for independently directing daytoday project execution, establishing projectspecific objectives, priorities, policies, and procedures, and ensuring accountability across all project disciplines.
Serve as a senior representative of the client in coordinating with ownership, internationally recognized architects and designers, engineering consultants, contractors, operators, and regulatory agencies. Lead highlevel project meetings, drive critical decisions, and provide executivelevel briefings on project milestones, financial performance, risks, and strategic recommendations.
Exercise independent judgment in anticipating and resolving complex project challenges, proactively identifying risks, evaluating technical and commercial implications, and implementing effective solutions while escalating major strategic matters to the Project Director.
Provide leadership and direction to multidisciplinary project teams, holding consultants and contractors accountable for performance, deliverables, and project objectives. Mentor junior project staff in technical coordination, design management, and project management methodologies and standards.

Pre-Development

Lead early planning efforts, including site analysis, feasibility studies, land planning, area programming, master planning, infrastructure assessments, and conceptual design, ensuring alignment with the client’s development objectives and ultraluxury hospitality expectations.
Direct technical due diligence of site conditions, infrastructure, environmental constraints, and development risks to inform project decisions.
Lead preliminary budgets, cost estimates, financial models, and master schedules; assess design feasibility and construction approaches.
Recommend project delivery, contracting, procurement, phasing, and bid packaging strategies suited to remote island logistics and available resources.
Coordinate entitlements, permitting, and regulatory approvals, identifying potential obstacles early.
Challenge early design solutions to align architectural vision with constructability, infrastructure, cost, and schedule.

Pre-Construction

Establish project communication, document control, roles, and accountability across international teams; lead design coordination and project control meetings.
Direct the multidisciplinary design process from concept through construction documentation, managing internationally recognized architects, engineers, interior designers, and specialty consultants to ensure coordinated, technically sound deliverables that meet project quality, schedule, and budget objectives.
Critically evaluate architectural and engineering designs for technical feasibility, interdisciplinary coordination, constructability, regulatory compliance, and alignment with the client's vision and luxury hospitality brand standards. Identify deficiencies, challenge proposed solutions, and direct appropriate corrective measures.
Evaluate detailed budgets, schedules, cash flow, and design cost exposure; identify cost and schedule impacts of design decisions and recommend mitigation.
Direct comprehensive design reviews, value engineering initiatives, peer reviews, and constructability assessments, balancing architectural integrity, technical performance, construction feasibility, cost, and schedule without compromising the intended design quality.
Oversee coordination of complex structural systems, building envelopes, waterproofing, MEP systems, highend architectural finishes, FF and E, IT/lowvoltage systems, and other ownerfurnished components, ensuring seamless integration across design, procurement, and construction disciplines.
Coordinate permitting and regulatory reviews with local authorities and technical consultants; proactively address schedule risks.
Lead procurement and contracting activities, including RFQ/RFP development, consultant and contractor prequalification, bid evaluation, negotiations, contract awards, and buyout. Develop procurement strategies addressing international sourcing, shipping logistics, limited local resources, and longlead materials and equipment.
Oversee consultant and contractor agreement administration, financial controls, invoice review, and tracking of budgeted, committed, actual, and projected costs. Evaluate commercial risks, proposed changes, and potential cost exposures to protect the client's financial interests.
Oversee project QA/QC procedures and risk and issue registers; proactively resolve technical, commercial, and logistical challenges.

Construction Management

Direct and oversee general contractors and multidisciplinary construction teams, lead OAC and project control group meetings, and assume primary responsibility for daytoday construction execution, including complex sequencing, site logistics, infrastructure coordination, and adherence to project quality, schedule, and budget objectives.
Provide seniorlevel technical oversight of construction activities, critically evaluating structural systems, building envelopes, waterproofing, MEP installations, construction methodologies, and highend architectural finishes. Proactively identify deficiencies, resolve complex field conditions, and direct consultants and contractors in implementing technically sound solutions.
Oversee the review and resolution of submittals, RFIs, shop drawings, substitution requests, change proposals, and change orders. Evaluate technical and commercial implications, challenge unnecessary costs or design complexities, and review and approve monthly payment requests in accordance with contractual requirements and delegated authority.
Direct construction quality assurance and quality control activities, oversee special inspections, site safety compliance, insurance requirements, construction schedules, and FF and E installation. Monitor contractor performance and enforce accountability for workmanship, coordination, and adherence to the project's luxury design and construction standards.
Oversee construction reporting and provide executive updates on milestones, financial performance, schedule risks, technical issues, and corrective actions.
Direct substantial completion and project closeout activities, including inspections, punch lists, occupancy approvals, commissioning, record drawings, warranties, contract closeouts, final payments, digital turnover, and coordination with hospitality operators and client representatives to ensure operational readiness and successful handover.
Other duties may be assigned.

A minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible construction or project management experience.
Demonstrated experience managing complex, multidisciplinary design teams throughout the project life cycle.

who shall contribute to large scale strategic Customer projects and initially contribute to a key initiative to standardize Zayo’s legacy dark fiber service records in the field and within various ordering, design, GIS, and billing systems. This initiative will enhance operational efficiency, streamline maintenance, and improve accuracy in troubleshooting and network redesign. This exciting initiative is national in scope and will focus on Zayo’s largest dark fiber Customers, including both Long Haul and Metro Dark Fiber services.

Our STPM
is a subject matter expert in process management, is a critical thinker, and has the ability to manage detailed deliverables. This hands-on role requires a multi-disciplinary skillset that leverages strong system and process knowledge in network and fiber services implementation and operations. The STPM
will analyze services, plan projects and generate service orders, manage risks and issues, define and manage dependencies, manage milestones, generate technical documentation, and meet or exceed KPIs. They are a key project planner, trusted advisor, and hands-on leader who collaborates cross-functionally with Customers, Salespersons, Engineers, Outside Plant PMs, and all operational support teams.

Responsibilities

End-to-End project planner and owner who shall:

Audit historical Contacts, network designs, redlines, and invoices (where necessary) to scope and plan projects for specific regional markets and long haul fiber routes
Develop, issue, and manage specific market projects and groups of orders for service/record conversion
Generate technical documentation and validate closeout packages before issuing to Customers
Develop remedial plans where defects are identified in Service Delivery
Coordinate and implement bulk system updates and billing changes with Customers
Independently orchestrate internal and external customer project communication timeline, milestones and progress
Partner with Sales to drive ongoing customer service improvement strategies
Develop, maintain, and report performance metrics and perform analysis to support regular status reporting and cross-functional Customer Business Reviews
Develop and maintain customer project plans based on contractual requirements and service designs
Perform and oversee daily PM operational tasks working cross-functionally.
Manage existing reports and dashboards to provide weekly and quarterly forecasting, metrics and deliverables.
Communicate and coordinate plans and strategies with other functional areas including sales, product, engineering, procurement, network operations and field operations.

Qualifications

Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in telecom technical project management
Software Experience: Salesforce, Network Manager/IQGEO, MSOffice & Google Suite with Advanced spreadsheet skillset, MSVisio, and XL-Connector
Comfortable with larger datasets, with confidence to perform system and record bulk loads and updates
Complex knowledge of systems/tools, processes, and application of project management methodology at strategic and tactical levels.
Knowledge of Fiber Engineering, Outside Plant, and field operations processes required for each project inclusive of  budget, design, engineering, and scheduling.
Exceptional project leadership and critical thinking skills; Excellent customer management skills (verbal and written) including risk analysis and conflict management/resolution
Ability to influence teams to action that are not in a direct reporting relationship to drive toward company goals
Self driven and motivated to provide exceptional customer service
Ability to address complex personal gaps/growth areas; desire to continually improve and move up in the organization
Bachelor’s degree in a related field required

Travel

Occasional travel may be needed for the STPM candidate for customer requested market meetings or to meet in-market with Zayo internal teams.

Estimated base salary range: $95,100 - $146,300 USD/annually.

Established in 2021, Independence Pet Holdings
is a corporate holding company that manages a diverse and broad portfolio of modern pet health brands and services, including insurance, pet education, lost recovery services, and more throughout North America.

We believe pet insurance is more than a financial product and build solutions to simplify the pet parenting journey and help improve the well-being of pets. As a leading authority in the pet category, we operate with a full stack of resources, capital, and services to support pet parents. Our multi-brand and omni-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands.

Job Summary

Doubtless, formerly known as Independence Pet Holdings (IPH) is undertaking a multi-year enterprise transformation to modernize its technology and data ecosystem and establish scalable, data-driven capabilities across its operating companies globally.

The Program Manager – Data & Analytics is responsible for leading execution and coordinated delivery of strategic enterprise data and analytics initiatives across IPH’s evolving data platform landscape, including cloud data platforms, reporting and analytics modernization, data integrations, governance enablement, and AI-driven capabilities.

Reporting into the Technology Portfolio & Delivery Office (TPDO), this role partners closely with IPH Data & Enterprise Analytics (IDEA) leadership, business program leaders, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, security, and third-party delivery teams to drive execution alignment, delivery accountability, and coordinated outcomes across multiple concurrent workstreams.

This role requires strong execution discipline, organizational leadership, and delivery management capabilities within complex enterprise environments. The successful candidate will lead integrated planning, dependency management, risk mitigation, and execution governance in support of IPH’s broader enterprise transformation initiatives and data modernization strategy.

Focus Areas

Data Platform Delivery

Lead and coordinate delivery activities across enterprise data platform, analytics, reporting, integration, and AI enablement initiatives to support successful execution against transformation objectives.

Transformation Enablement

Drive modernization of enterprise data capabilities, governance processes, analytics platforms, and operational reporting practices across IPH operating companies.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Partner closely with business, data, architecture, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams to drive execution alignment, dependency management, and issue resolution.

Execution Governance

Drive visibility into delivery status, risks, dependencies, milestones, financials, and operational metrics across enterprise data and analytics workstreams.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and coordinate delivery activities across enterprise data and analytics initiatives, including cloud data platforms, reporting modernization, data integrations, governance enablement, and AI-related capabilities
Drive integrated planning and execution coordination with business program managers, data leaders, engineering teams, architects, and system integrators
Lead Agile / SAFe delivery routines, including planning sessions, dependency management, status reviews, RAID management, and execution tracking activities
Lead integrated roadmap coordination across data engineering, analytics, integrations, infrastructure, security, and business workstreams
Drive visibility and accountability for program milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, financials, and action items across multiple delivery teams
Lead coordination with vendors and third-party delivery partners to monitor deliverables, escalate blockers, and ensure execution accountability
Build and maintain executive-ready delivery dashboards, status reporting, and operational metrics across enterprise data initiatives
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Information Security, and Engineering teams to ensure aligned and predictable delivery outcomes
Lead operational readiness, release coordination, testing alignment, and deployment planning activities across data and analytics initiatives
Ensure delivery activities align with TPDO governance standards, reporting requirements, financial controls, and operational processes
Collaborate closely with business and Data leadership to ensure alignment between technology delivery activities and broader enterprise data transformation objectives
Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery governance, operational cadence, reporting standards, and transformation execution practices

Required Skills & Abilities

Strong delivery coordination and execution management skills across complex enterprise technology and data initiatives
Ability to manage competing priorities and operate effectively within fast-paced transformation environments
Strong organizational, planning, dependency management, and problem-solving capabilities
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate across business, data, and technology organizations
Experience leading Agile / SAFe delivery models and cross-functional delivery coordination
Ability to facilitate collaboration across distributed engineering teams, vendors, and third-party delivery partners
Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to maintain visibility across interconnected workstreams and dependencies
Demonstrated ability to proactively identify risks, escalate issues, drive execution transparency, and ensure accountability across delivery teams
Acts as a collaborative leader who promotes a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, operational excellence, and execution discipline

Education And Experience

8+ years of technology program or project management experience supporting enterprise data and or analytics delivery initiatives
Experience supporting enterprise data platforms, analytics modernization, cloud data ecosystems, or AI enablement initiatives preferred
Familiarity with data engineering, reporting, analytics, governance, or enterprise data platform concepts
Experience working with cloud data platforms such as Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar ecosystems preferred
Experience working with system integrators, offshore delivery teams, and third-party vendors
Experience supporting enterprise transformation initiatives within regulated industries preferred
Experience working within Agile / SAFe delivery environments
Strong understanding of enterprise delivery governance, reporting, financial tracking, and dependency management practices
Bachelor’s degree in Information technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, Analytics, or related field

NYC Base pay range: $135,026 - $168,784 per year

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM
is seeking a Project Manager –Transmission & Distribution
with a passion for driving results to join our high-performing energy practice team.

In this role, the project manager will plan, direct, and execute moderate to large sized projects to support electric utilities. Our Project Managers are AECOM’s leaders readily managing, leading project teams, and delivering technical excellence, to provide client satisfaction through the use of structured processes and tools. This position will be on a REMOTE basis.

AECOM’s Energy practice provides a wide range of services from consulting and engineering design to energy engineering, energy procurement and construction (EPC) for power, energy efficiency, and renewable energy clients. Our understanding of the big picture – and the interconnection between generation, distribution, storage, and the demand side of the meter – allows us to deliver holistic strategies that improve and modernize next generation energy infrastructure. We connect knowledge and experience across our global framework to bring together a unique combination of engineers, planners, scientists, and project managers who advance cleaner, secure, and more sustainable energy solutions.

The job responsibilities of the position will include but are not limited to:
Use their strong working knowledge of transmission electric utilities to manage the full life cycle of substation or transmission projects.
Be responsible for design, permitting, construction, community engagement, and establishing/achieving critical project milestones.
Utilize your strong interpersonal, organizational, and creative problem-solving skills, to collaborate and lead project stake holders.
Work closely with the Project Team to confirm deliverables and services are being provided to exceed client’s satisfaction. This includes coordination with team members across the world.
Identify project opportunities early and facilitate go/no-go decisions, determine project fees, write proposals, prepare and lead client presentations, and negotiation of contracts.
Support development and maintenance of business plan; lead and support proposal efforts to support profitable growth.
Enjoy building teams, capturing new work, and growing Client relationships.
Take ownership of internal project financials, staffing, legal coordination, and risk management.
Be results-oriented with strong interpersonal, organizational, problem-solving, collaboration and leadership skills.
Enjoy managing projects that vary in size and complexity in multiple locations.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related field and 4 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
Project Management experience directly related to transmission and substation engineering projects
Demonstrated experience delivering complex projects and/or programs with high quality on schedule and within scope and budget

Preferred Qualifications:

Masters Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related field
Project Management Professional (PMP)
5+ years of relevant experience, including project management program management engineering of transmission and substation work

Additional Information

Relocation assistance is not available for this role.
Sponsorship for US Employment Authorization is not available for this position.
THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY JANUARY 29, 2027.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $100000 to $140000.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Manager
to support the client while acting as the primary liaison between the client and SGX.
The ideal candidate will have strong project management expertise, fluency in English
and a solid understanding of artwork production workflows
. This role requires managing multiple projects simultaneously
, ensuring seamless communication
, and driving operational excellence
.

Client Artwork Management

Oversee and maintain artwork files within the client’s artwork management system, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with specifications.
Upload, organize, and track artwork assets throughout the project lifecycle.
Ensure all artwork files are correctly tagged, categorized, and archived.
Troubleshoot and resolve any artwork-related issues within the DAM system.
Provide training and support to both internal and external teams on workflow system usage.
Enforce adherence to client-specific style guides to maintain brand consistency.
Apply and review brand guidelines to ensure accuracy and consistency across packaging

Studio Liaison

Serve as the primary point of contact between the client and the SGX.
Clearly communicate project requirements, timelines, and feedback to all stakeholders.
Monitor project progress and ensure all deadlines are met.
Coordinate artwork approvals and revisions, facilitating a smooth workflow.
Resolve any issues that arise during the artwork production process.
Provide regular project status updates internally and to client’s Packaging Design Operations team and business.
Organize and lead client meetings and presentations.

Project Management

Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and budgets.
Prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Identify and mitigate project risks to ensure smooth execution.
Ensure all deliverables meet quality standards before final submission.
Utilize project management tools to track progress and communicate with stakeholders.
Maintain detailed project documentation for reference and reporting.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

Ensure packaging layouts align with brand guidelines through careful implementation and review.
Serve as the client’s brand guardian, ensuring global consistency in artwork production.
Capture and manage a repository of client nuances, brand assets, and standard processes.
Oversee daily system reviews to ensure accuracy in project execution.
Verify all technical specifications and supplied data align with project requirements.
Ensure order entries are complete and concise before production begins.

Collaboration & Leadership

Share insights on client preferences and workflows to maintain consistency across the SGX production network.
Collaborate with internal teams to optimize workflow efficiency.
Exhibit a strong problem-solving mindset and sense of urgency in issue resolution.

Reporting & Process Optimization

Maintain CRM data, ensuring all project updates are accurately recorded.
Provide weekly status reports to both internal and external stakeholders.
Support audit processes, manufacturer reviews, and distribution tracking.
Stay updated on pricing matrices and workflow adjustments in the CRM system.
Contribute to process improvement initiatives to drive operational excellence.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
3-5+ years of experience in project management, artwork production, or a related field.
Strong understanding of artwork production processes and workflows.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Fluency in English (both written and verbal).
Proficiency in project management software and tools.
Strong organizational and time-management
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.
Strong problem-solving and customer service

Preferred:

Experience in packaging, printing, or life sciences industries.
Knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite.
Skilled in redlining with exceptional attention to detail.
PMP certification or equivalent project management credentials.
Fluency in other EMEA languages is a plus not essential.

, and operations across 30

Senior Project Manager II, Client Onboarding & Implementation-Full Time (Remote)

Our Organization

CDP, a Boston-based public benefit corporation, uses the collaborative fundraising model to improve the operational efficiency and revenue generation capacity of the public media system. CDP currently provides more than 230 NPR and PBS public media organizations (PMOs) with outsourced marketing, data analytics, fundraising, and technology services. These services help PMOs raise more net income, grow their donor files faster, lower their fundraising costs, and free up development talent allowing stations to better focus on local engagement. Since its inception, CDP has delivered more than $1 billion in membership revenue for local PMOs participating in its services and has become the most widely adopted Public Media service in the history of public broadcasting.

Just as CDP is committed to supporting public media organizations around the country, we are equally committed to supporting each of our team in their own professional development.

For more information, visit www.cdpcommunity.org.

Role Overview

The Enterprise Project Management Office is seeking a Sr. Project Manager to join our Client Onboarding Team. Onboarding plays a critical role in helping public media organizations achieve their mission. In this role, you’ll guide client stations through one of the biggest organizational changes they’ll make: onboarding to CDP’s Member Services Bureau (MSB).

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building strong client partnerships, and navigating ambiguity. Every implementation is unique, requiring a balance of strategic thinking, adaptability, and hands-on execution. Beyond leading successful implementations, you’ll identify patterns across engagements, using those insights to help shape onboarding strategy, drive improvements, and translate lessons learned into better frameworks, decisions, and outcomes for every client that follows.
