new_jobs.title: Cyber Threat Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Quantum Sky is seeking an experienced, analytical Cyber Threat Analyst
to join our Defensive Cyber Operations (DCO) team supporting Defense Information Systems Agency Pacific (DISA PAC) at Ford Island, Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, HI. Operating under the Global Services Management – Operations II (GSM-O II) Task Order 22 (TN22) Boundary Cyber Defense and Cybersecurity Services Provider (CSSP) contract, our mission is to defend the Department of Defense Information Network (DODIN/DISN), U.S. Pacific Command (USPACOM), and critical mission partner enclaves against sophisticated advanced persistent threats and nation-state cyber actors.

In this high-impact intelligence and analysis role, you will synthesize multi-source intelligence, telemetry, and forensic data into actionable threat intelligence. You will analyze adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), formulate threat indicators, track advanced adversary campaigns, and direct threat-informed defense operations across perimeter boundaries, multi-cloud platforms, and classified networks—spanning Unclassified (NIPRNet) and Secret (SIPRNet) up to Top Secret/SCI.

Responsibilities:

Boundary Threat Analysis & Adversary Characterization:
Warning Intelligence & Attack Sensing:
Analyze boundary sensor feeds, Netflow, and IDS/IPS logs in conjunction with intelligence agencies, peer CSSPs, and commercial intelligence providers to deliver Warning Intelligence and Attack Sensing and Warning activities compliant with DoDI 8530.01.
Adversary Campaign Tracking:
Apply the MITRE ATT&CK®
and Cyber Kill Chain frameworks to characterize adversary behavior, track campaign evolution, identify "Living off the Land" (LotL) tradecraft, and assess the operational impact of targeted threats traversing enterprise Internet Access Points and Boundary Cloud Access Points.
Actionable Battlefield Intelligence:
Author, refine, and disseminate high-impact, actionable battlefield cyber threat analysis products, Threat Warnings, and Tippers that empower tactical defenders and boundary engineers to preempt emerging cyber assaults.
Automated Telemetry & Breach Assessment:
Evaluate bypasses and telemetry from automated blocking platforms to uncover adversary evasion techniques, evaluate malicious patterns, and generate targeted analytic hypotheses.
Operational Reporting & DJOC Synchronization:
Coordinate closely with the DISA Joint Operations Center (DJOC), USPACOM J6, DoD Cyber Defense Command (DCDC), USCYBERCOM, and the National Security Agency (NSA) to synchronize threat analyses and maintain standardized incident reporting in the DoD-mandated reporting structure (currently Rally).

Enterprise CSSP Intelligence & Proactive Threat Hunting:
Deliberate Defense (DD) & Discovery Counter Infiltration (DCI):
Formulate threat hypotheses based on all-source intelligence, reconstruct multi-stage adversary attack paths, and conduct structured threat-hunting across enterprise endpoints and cloud enclaves to validate malicious presence or confirm its absence.
Multi-Cloud & Zero Trust Threat Analysis:
Track advanced persistent threats operating against enterprise cloud ecosystems (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) secured under the Joint Warfighter Cloud Capability, Thunderdome Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and Microsoft Defender suite (EndGuard).
Analytic Capability & Use Case Development:
Translate threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into specific detection use cases, rule logic, and detection requirements for ingestion into enterprise SIEMs (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, and JCRS-D).
Aggregated Threat Trend Reporting:
Aggregate threat indicators, malware behaviors, and adversary profiles from commercial threat feeds (e.g., CrowdStrike, VirusTotal) and internal investigations; provide inputs for the quarterly Aggregated Cyber Awareness Report detailing strategic threat forecasts and vulnerability exposures.
Vulnerability & Exposure Intelligence:
Continuously assess Information Assurance Vulnerability Management notices (IAVAs and IAVBs) against active adversary exploitation trends, providing technical threat context and impact assessments to mission partner enclaves.

Location-Specific & Above-Secret Intelligence: PACOM & TS/SCI:
PACOM Mission Network (PMN) and Joint Operational Edge – Coalition Environment (JOE-CE) Threat Assessment:
Provide dedicated cyber threat intelligence and behavioral profiling tailored to the PMN and JOE-CE operational networks.
User & Entity Behavioral Profiling:
Analyze Identity, Credential, and Access Management telemetry and the PMN Master User Record to identify anomalous user behavior, insider threats, and sophisticated lateral movement.
SCIF-Based Intelligence Operations:
Conduct all-source cyber analysis within Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIF) at Ford Island, examining multi-discipline intelligence across JWICS, YLAN, and special-access enclaves up to Top Secret / SCI.
Cross-Echelon Coordination:
Brief Senior Executive and military leadership across USPACOM, DISA PAC, and operational mission partners on adversary threat capabilities, active campaigns, and strategic risk postures.

Required:

Level II (Intermediate): Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Intelligence Studies, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline with 2+ years of direct experience in cyber threat intelligence, all-source cyber analysis, or Computer Network Defense (CND); OR an Associate degree with 4+ years; OR 6+ years of relevant professional/military cyber intelligence experience in lieu of a degree.
Level III (Senior): Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of relevant experience; OR an Associate degree with 6+ years; OR 8+ years of relevant experience / military service in lieu of a degree.
Must hold a valid certification or degree compliant with DoD 8140.03 / DCWF Work Role Code 531: Cyber Defense Incident Responder or equivalent (Intermediate proficiency level) prior to start date:
Accepted Certifications include: CompTIA CySA+, GCTI (GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence), CEH, CFR, GCIA, GCIH, CND, or advanced credentials such as CISSP, CASP+ CE, or GCFA.
Privileged Access (SA/SSP) eligibility: Willingness to obtain and maintain system access credentials as required by operational mission requirements.
In-depth understanding of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, threat actor attribution, and mapping adversary activity to the MITRE ATT&CK®
Experience authoring structured threat intelligence products, technical threat briefs, intelligence summaries, and operational Tippers.
Proven ability to analyze raw packet captures, Netflow, proxy/DNS logs, firewall telemetry, and endpoint logs to reconstruct adversary intrusions.
Hands-on familiarity querying enterprise SIEM platforms (Splunk SPL, Elastic/Kibana, Microsoft Sentinel KQL).
Working knowledge of common threat intelligence platforms and tools (e.g., MISP, ThreatConnect, Anomali, VirusTotal, Shodan).
Willingness and ability to work standard operational shifts with occasional surge/after-hours support during critical incidents or crisis contingencies.
Must be a U.S. Citizen.

Desired:

Prior experience supporting USPACOM, DISA Pacific, DJOC, Joint Cyber Centers, or Service Component DCO units (e.g., 10th Fleet, 16th Air Force, ARCYBER).
Experience conducting structured threat-hunting (DCI/DD) across cloud and enterprise on-premises networks.
Knowledge of malware triage and dynamic/static analysis concepts (e.g., sandboxing, de-obfuscation, hashing, C2 extraction).
Familiarity with AI prompting (Gemini, Grok, ChatGPT) for automation and OSINT data collection.
Direct background working with DoD incident response frameworks (CJCSM 6510.01F, DoDI 8530.01) and reporting platforms (Rally, DISS).

Clearance:

Active Top Secret security clearance with eligibility to obtain SCI access upon start (Tier 5 / SSBI investigation within scope). Candidates holding an active Secret clearance may be considered provided Top Secret/SCI processing begins immediately upon hire with government approval.

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. Job Summary

Senior Information Security Analyst - Attack Surface Management Lead

The Opportunity

The Mass General Brigham Senior Information Security Analyst – Attack Surface Management Function Lead will be responsible for advancing and coordinating the MGB Attack Surface Management capability across vulnerability discovery, penetration testing, attack surface analysis, and attack simulation.

This impactful role will help lead the function into a risk-driven, validation-focused capability that identifies meaningful exposure, prioritizes remediation based on exploitability and business impact, and connects findings to detection engineering, threat hunting, threat intelligence, and broader Cyber Defense priorities.

The ideal candidate is a deeply technical security professional with experience in vulnerability management, offensive security, exposure analysis, penetration testing, or adversary simulation. They should be comfortable translating technical findings into actionable risk narratives, guiding engineers through complex analysis, and helping prioritize work based on business risk, asset criticality, threat relevance, and exploitability.

Expertise for Success

Vulnerability discovery and vulnerability management
Attack surface analysis and exposure management
Penetration testing and exploit validation
Attack simulation, adversary emulation, or breach and attack simulation

What You'll Do

Vulnerability Discovery: Support and mature processes to identify vulnerabilities across infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, endpoints, and externally exposed assets. Ensure findings are enriched with asset context, ownership, severity, exploitability, and business impact to support effective prioritization and remediation.
Attack Surface Analysis: Analyze exposed assets, services, technologies, identities, ownership gaps, and environmental risk to identify meaningful exposure. Translate attack surface data into actionable recommendations for risk reduction.
Penetration Testing Coordination: Support penetration testing activities, including scoping, methodology, technical validation, reporting, and remediation follow-up. Ensure findings are clearly documented, risk-ranked, and connected to broader Cyber Defense improvement opportunities.
Attack Simulation: Coordinate and support attack simulation and adversary emulation activities to validate security controls, response processes, and detection coverage. Map activity to MITRE ATT&CK where appropriate and recommend improvements to preventive, detective, and response capabilities.
Remediation Prioritization: Prioritize remediation activity based on exploitability, asset criticality, business context, exposure, and threat relevance. Partner with technology owners to communicate findings clearly and track remediation through appropriate workflows.
Detection and Threat Hunting Handoffs: Partner with Security Detections, Threat Intelligence, and Threat Hunting teams to ensure ASM findings inform detection engineering, hunt development, and intelligence-driven security priorities.
Program Maturity: Develop and maintain repeatable processes, SOPs, playbooks, reporting standards, and quality expectations for ASM workflows. Identify opportunities to improve consistency, scalability, and operational maturity across the function.
Incident Response Support: Support the incident response team by providing insight into potential attack paths, exploitable vulnerabilities, exposed assets, and adversary techniques that may be relevant during a cyber incident.
Written Documentation: Create, review, and update documentation related to attack surface management processes, findings, reports, remediation recommendations, playbooks, and security controls.
Communication: Provide clear and concise written and verbal communication, including technical reporting, long-form documentation, stakeholder updates, and executive presentations. Translate technical detail into language appropriate for the intended audience.
Industry Knowledge: Maintain awareness of emerging vulnerabilities, attacker techniques, offensive security methods, exposure management practices, and technologies that may impact MGB’s security posture.

MGB Values: Use Mass General Brigham values to guide decisions, actions, and behaviors, including Patients, Affordability, Accountability & Service Commitment, Decisiveness, Innovation & Thoughtful Risk, Diversity & Inclusion, Integrity & Respect, Learning, Continuous Improvement & Personal Growth, and Teamwork & Collaboration.

new_jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About QuadReal Property Group

QuadReal Property Group is a global real estate investment, development and operating company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Its assets under management are $98.5 billion. From its foundation in Canada as a full-service real estate operating company, QuadReal has expanded its capabilities globally for investments in equity and debt in both the public and private markets. QuadReal invests directly through operating platforms in which it holds an ownership interest and via programmatic partnerships.

QuadReal seeks to deliver strong investment returns while creating sustainable environments that bring value to the people and communities it serves. Now and for generations to come.

QuadReal: Excellence lives here.

www.quadreal.com

Role Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Security Analyst to join our growing cybersecurity team. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and responding to security incidents, as well as helping to strengthen QuadReal’s overall security posture.

Responsibilities

Investigate security incidents, perform root cause analysis, and document findings and remediation steps.
Conduct regular vulnerability scans, interpret results, and coordinate with stakeholders to remediate identified risks.
Design and execute phishing simulation campaigns and support the cyber security training program to improve user awareness.
Develop and maintain security documentation, including incident response playbooks, SOPs, and risk assessments.
Assist in the implementation and enforcement of security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring alignment with industry standards (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001)
Collaborate with other teams to ensure secure configurations and practices across systems and environments.
Track and report on key security metrics and trends to support continuous improvement.
Stay informed on the latest cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, and regulatory developments.

Experience And Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the following areas: Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Vulnerability Management, Network Security, Identity and Access Management.
Strong experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, VM, DLP, email security technologies.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and industry standards such as NIST CSF, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK.
Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, and other network protocols, as well as firewall and IDS/IPS technologies.
Industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP, GSEC, or equivalent are highly desirable.
Experience with cloud security tools and practices, particularly in Microsoft Azure environments.
Knowledge of identity and access management (IAM), including MFA, SSO, conditional access, and role-based access control.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
Thrives in collaborative environments and contributes positively to team dynamics

The expected annualized base salary range for this position is between $75,000-$95,000.

Based on the position, QuadReal offers a competitive total rewards package in addition to the base pay, which may include a performance-based incentive plan, comprehensive health & dental benefits, pension plan, and paid time off.

The actual salary offered will take into consideration a wide array of factors including, but not limited to, the individual’s skill, experience, education and training, the market compensation of the role, and the consideration to internal equity.

We value diverse experiences and perspectives. Even if your skills don’t align 100% with the listed qualifications or salary range, we encourage you to apply – you may be a great fit for this role or others in our community. Applicants may also be considered for alternative positions within the organization where their qualifications and experience align more closely with available opportunities.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) technology — alongside human review — to assist in screening and assessing applicants for this position. Our recruitment team remains involved in all decisions.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada as the company does not provide work permit sponsorship for this role.

Note to Recruiters: QuadReal does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to QuadReal, directly or indirectly, will be considered QuadReal property. QuadReal will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. A recruiting agency must first have a valid, written and fully executed agency agreement contract for engaged services to submit resumes.

QuadReal Property Group will provide reasonable accommodation at any time throughout the hiring process for applicants with disabilities or for those needing job postings in an alternate format. If you require accommodation, please advise the Talent Acquisition team member you are working with and include the following: Job posting #, your name and your preferred method of contact.

new_jobs.description:
STR is seeking a Lead Intelligence Analyst to join a new group focused on the complex test and evaluation challenges that exist in the modern world.

You will help build and guide an expert team capable of planning, executing, analyzing, and delivering decision-quality results at the speed the Department of War (DoW) requires to field advancements that continue to outpace our adversaries. STR's approach will emphasize product-based delivery of test solutions through an experienced, trusted team that can rapidly adapt to evolving customer needs.

What you will do:

Research, understand, and lead innovations in intelligence implementations for developmental systems under test. Identify unique and varied opportunities to apply intelligence proficiencies and resources to test activities.
Identify customer requirements for intelligence, digest unique problem sets, and apply analytic techniques to solve complex challenges in the test community.
Effectively use intelligence tools, resources, and contacts in the intelligence community to generate products tailored to customers' unique requirements, analyzing multi-domain threats across the core intelligence disciplines: SIGINT, MASINT, OSINT, GEOINT, and HUMINT.
Lead intelligence team members and connect internal and external customers with intelligence community resources to generate robust analytic analyses for dissemination to national defense and cleared defense industrial base leaders.
Collaborate with engineering and test teams to ensure systems under test achieve parity with pacing threats.

Who you are:

Bachelor's degree with at least 7 years of relevant experience; Master's degree with at least 5 years of relevant experience; PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience; or equivalent experience in intelligence analysis, intelligence operations, or a related field.
This position requires an active Top Secret security clearance with eligibility to support Special Access Programs (SAP), for which U.S. citizenship is required by the U.S. Government.
Expert understanding and experience with intelligence support to the U.S. developmental and operational test and evaluation enterprise.
Expertise in intelligence tools including Fade/MIST, Thresher, WedFISH, MIDB, MARS, and SNOOP.
Demonstrated leadership of professional intelligence teams.
Established connections within the intelligence community, with verifiable support to relevant areas of responsibility (AORs), including PACOM, CENTCOM, and EUCOM.
Military experience with an Associate of Science (A.S.) in Intelligence Studies.

Nice to haves:

Experience working at or in close coordination with U.S. western test ranges, including the Nevada Test and Training Range (NTTR), Utah Test and Training Range (UTTR), Naval Air Weapons Station China Lake, or comparable facilities.
Working knowledge of Department of Defense (DoD) and Intelligence Community (IC) missions and acquisition processes.
Experience working in joint environments.
Certified instructor (ACC Classroom Instructor Course or equivalent)

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $173,000 - $220,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Final offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, SOX Compliance
new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic is growing fast, and our SOX program needs to keep up. Many of the controls that matter for financial reporting run on engineering systems: who can access production and financial systems, how code changes are reviewed and deployed, and how usage is metered and billed.

We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to own the technology side of our SOX program. You'll work across engineering, security, GRC, Finance, and Internal Audit to design and run IT controls, drive gaps to closure, and make compliance lighter for engineering teams. You’ll also use Claude to automate evidence collection and control testing, so the program scales without more manual work.

Responsibilities

Own the technology side of the SOX program end-to-end, from planning and control design through evidence, testing, remediation, and year-end reporting
Work with engineering teams to design and roll out IT general controls and IT application controls
Work with engineering teams to build Claude-based workflows, tools, and dashboards to automate evidence collection, control testing, and monitoring that warns engineering teams about compliance issues before an audit finds them
Lead large SOX projects, such as bringing new systems into scope, with clear success criteria, dependencies, and delivery dates
Turn control requirements into concrete engineering work with clear scope, owners, and deadlines, and a design that fits how our teams already build and ship
Build processes to evaluate new products, systems, and major engineering changes for SOX impact before they ship, so the right controls are in place from the start
Build strong working relationships with engineering control owners, help them understand what their controls require, and support them in producing evidence for auditor requests
Investigate control failures down to root cause, and drive engineering teams to fix them in time for the fix to be tested
Help keep an up-to-date list of the systems, apps, and infrastructure in SOX scope, with an owner named for each control
Track system migrations and scope changes, and make sure controls are updated as systems move
Build metrics and dashboards on control health, open findings, and remediation progress
Give regular updates on program status, risks, and remediation to technical leadership
Keep improving the program: simplify control processes, remove manual steps, and raise the share of controls that run cleanly

You may be a good fit if you

Have 7+ years of experience in technical program management, IT audit, or technology compliance, with a focus on SOX and IT general controls
Have run or supported a SOX program at a public or pre-IPO company
Have used automation or AI tools to make compliance work faster and more reliable
Know IT general controls and IT application controls in depth, including access management, change management, and application controls, and how they support financial reporting
Have worked closely with external auditors
Understand cloud infrastructure and engineering workflows, such as code review, CI/CD, and cloud access, well enough to work through a control design with an engineer
Can explain technical risks and control gaps clearly to executives and other non-technical audiences
Are comfortable driving outcomes across engineering, finance, and audit teams that don't report to you

Strong candidates may also have

A background in software, systems, or security engineering
Hands-on experience building with Claude Code or other AI tools
Experience with automated controls in revenue or order-to-cash systems, such as billing and usage metering
Experience with financial systems such as ERP and billing platforms, and the controls around them
Experience building or rebuilding a SOX program at a fast-growing company
Familiarity with other security and IT frameworks, such as NIST or ISO 27001

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$290,000—$365,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. new_jobs.description:
Summary

The Cybersecurity Manager (High-Tech Manufacturing & Semiconductors) leads the strategic alignment, implementation, and management of the organization's information and operational security frameworks. This role bridges the gap between complex enterprise risk strategies and practical technical engineering controls. Operating in a high-value manufacturing environment, this manager is primarily responsible for Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), while possessing the technical fluency required to collaborate effectively with IT, Operational Technology (OT), and engineering teams. The core mission is to protect proprietary intellectual property (IP), secure advanced fabrication supply chains, ensure operational uptime, and maintain audit readiness against global regulatory standards.

Responsibilities

Core Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Responsibilities
Framework Alignment: Define, execute, and mature information security policies mapped explicitly to ISO/IEC 27001, NIST SP 800-53, and semiconductor industry specifications (e.g., SEMI cybersecurity standards).
Risk Management & Audits: Lead formal risk assessments across corporate networks. Manage internal and external audits, compiling risk registers and mapping mitigation paths.
Third-Party Supply Chain Security: Establish comprehensive vendor assessment criteria to evaluate and continually audit external component suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and outsourced service providers.
Regulatory Compliance: Coordinate and ensure enterprise compliance with international regulations relevant to manufacturing data flows, including GDPR, export control constraints, and client-specific data non-disclosure mandates.
Incident Response Governance: Design, maintain, and run periodic simulation tabletops for the Cyber Incident Response Plan, ensuring clear communication pathways between executive stakeholders, legal counsel, and technical investigators.
Technical Oversight & Collaboration
OT/ICS Collaboration: Interface directly with operational technology and SCADA engineering teams to ensure GRC baselines extend to automated fabrication equipment, testing cleanrooms, and physical plant networks without disrupting production availability.
Architectural Alignment: Review technical designs for Identity & Access Management (IAM), network zoning/micro-segmentation, and zero-trust remote access architecture to ensure strict compliance with internal security baselines.
Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Collaborate with security operations and IT engineering to translate vulnerability scan results and penetration testing findings into prioritized, risk-based remediation plans for production-critical servers and workstations.

Qualifications

Education
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, Management Information Systems (MIS), Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Experience
5+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity or IT risk management, with a minimum of 2 years in a dedicated leadership or management function within a manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, or semiconductor environment.

Language
Mandarin speaking is a must.

Preferred
Technical Knowledge Base: Deep familiarity with network security constructs, IAM platforms, endpoint protection suites, SIEM logging architectures, and automated asset inventorying tools.

Industry Certifications: Professional management credentials are highly preferred (e.g., CISM, CISSP, CRISC, or CISA).

Location

This position will be on-site based in Sugar Land, Texas.

new_jobs.title: Information Security Manager (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
Über uns

Unsere Motivation sind Softwarelösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag unserer Kund*innen wirklich erleichtern und sie erfolgreicher machen. Das schaffen wir mit einem einzigartigen Team, Leidenschaft für Technologien, Mut für ausgefallene Wege und sehr viel Herzlichkeit, Ambition und Spaß bei der Arbeit.
Dein Team

Wir im internen IT-Team sorgen dafür, dass alle technischen Abläufe reibungslos funktionieren – von Hardware, Software und Netzwerken über zentrale Dienste wie Active Directory bis hin zu modernen Cloud-Services. Wir stellen die sichere und zuverlässige IT-Infrastruktur für alle Mitarbeitenden bereit, entwickeln Lösungen für effizientes Arbeiten und sind zentrale Anlaufstelle bei Fragen rund um IT und Informationssicherheit. Mit einem klaren Fokus auf Stabilität, Sicherheit und Innovation schaffen wir die Basis für produktives Arbeiten und den Schutz unserer Unternehmensinformationen.

Aufgaben

Informationssicherheit ist für dich kein Pflichtprogramm, sondern ein Thema, für das du brennst. Du kennst die wachsenden Herausforderungen, bewegst dich sicher zwischen Risiko, Governance und Technik und willst Security im Unternehmen wirksam voranbringen.
Du betreibst und entwickelst unser Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystem (ISMS) weiter – von Policies und Risikomanagement bis Awareness und Reporting.
Du koordinierst ISO-27001-/TISAX-Audits, externe Reviews und Zertifizierungen und begleitest die Bearbeitung der Findings.
Du koordinierst Security Assessments für Lieferanten, Services, Tools, AI Use Cases und Kundenanforderungen.
Du bringst bereichsübergreifende Security-Initiativen voran, übersetzt Risiken in konkrete Maßnahmen und behältst deren Umsetzung im Blick.
Du verbindest unser Information Security Governance Board mit den Business Units, Corporate Functions, technischen Expert*innen und externen Partnern; bei Blockern sorgst du für Klarheit und Eskalation.

Profil

Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Informationssicherheit mit und kennst dich fundiert mit Informationssicherheitsmanagement, ISO 27001 und Security Governance aus.
Ein gutes technisches Security-Verständnis zeichnet dich aus – insbesondere in den Bereichen Cloud, AI, Endpoint und Softwareentwicklung.
Du hast Erfahrung im Risiko-, Audit-, Maßnahmen- und Projektmanagement.
Teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit liegt dir: Du kommunizierst klar, koordinierst souverän und bleibst bei der Nachverfolgung verbindlich.
Du kannst technische, regulatorische und Management-Perspektiven zusammenbringen und findest pragmatische Lösungen.
Sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

Wir bieten

Home Office, Workation, Fahrrad-Leasing oder das perfekte Teilzeitmodell für dich. Unsere Benefits begleiten dich in deinem Arbeitsalltag bei itdesign und bieten dir vieles, was auch nach Feierabend Spaß macht und dein Leben verschönert.
Onboarding

Wir bereiten alles für deinen Start bei itdesign vor und geben dir alles an die Hand, damit du deine Aufgaben und Kolleg*innen kennenlernen kannst. Dabei helfen dir dein*e Mentor*in, dein individueller Einarbeitungsplan, Kennenlerngespräche und Schnupperpraktika.
Flexibel

Ob 40 Stunden oder dein individuelles Teilzeitmodell – wir gehen flexibel auf deine Bedürfnisse ein. All deine Stunden werden in einem Arbeitszeitkonto erfasst; Überstunden kannst du abfeiern.
Büro & Home Office

Wir freuen uns, wenn du ins Büro kommst. Genauso gerne darfst du auch im Home Office arbeiten. Manche Jobs sind auch zu 100% remote aus überall in Deutschland möglich. Egal wo dein Schreibtisch steht, wir versorgen dich mit Hardware.
Erholen & Workation

Du kannst es dir mit 30 Tagen Urlaub sowie Sonderurlaub bei besonderen Ereignissen gut gehen lassen. Außerdem kannst du Workation am Urlaubsort deiner Wahl machen.
Umweltbewusst

Ob Jobticket, Fahrrad-Leasing, Ökostrom oder eine eigene Solaranlage – Nachhaltigkeit ist uns wichtig. Daher haben wir eine CO2-Bilanz erstellt und arbeiten Schritt für Schritt daran, unseren Fußabdruck zu verkleinern.
Gesund

Mit einer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung sorgen wir dafür, dass du im Alltag gut versorgt bist. Auch dann, wenn es über die Standardleistungen hinausgeht.

Freitag ist Schulungstag und wir teilen intern unser Wissen miteinander. Außerdem haben wir alle einen jährlichen Kostenrahmen, welchen du für deine individuelle Weiterbildung nutzen kannst.

Flach & schnell

Wir arbeiten schnell, unkompliziert und auf direktem Dienstweg miteinander. Dabei sprechen wir viel miteinander, sind offen und geben einander Feedback.
Remote dabei

new_jobs.title: Information Security Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With

We are seeking an Information Security Operations Manager to lead our Information Security Analyst Team in Global Technology & Operations. This role is based at our Nashville, TN headquarters, four days in the office and one day remote each week. This is not an entry-level position.

The Information Security Operations team is responsible for safeguarding AllianceBernstein’s technology and information assets. The team’s primary focus is on identifying threats, monitoring, and responding to security events and enhancing the firm’s security posture. The Information Security Operations team operates as part of Infrastructure Risk Management (IRM), a department within Global Technology and Operations that is responsible for an enterprise-wide integrated infrastructure risk management program which employs a holistic approach to manage cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, physical security and business continuity led by the Chief Security Officer. This role reports to the Director of Information Security Risk and Operations.

What You'll Do

As the Information Security Operations Manager, you will perform a critical role working side by side with information security analysts as a hands-on player/coach, providing guidance, coaching, and training. You will also collaborate with other corporate business units including but not limited to global enterprise infrastructure and technology, corporate compliance, security assurance, global technology operations and other infrastructure risk business units. This position leads a team that provides information security analysis services, incident response services, and ultimately information risk management support to the business. Specifically, this team acts as an incident response team and control group to ensure that security operational procedures are performed, and risks are addressed in a timely manner. This team maintains a 24/7/365 on-call rotation.

Lead the daily operations of the information security operations program, aligning business objectives and risk tolerance.
Develop, implement, and continuously improve security procedures.
Actively participate in incident response and threat detection alongside the team, serving as a hands-on escalation point and ensuring rapid and effective resolution.
Track and report on key security metrics (e.g., MTTD, MTTR) to leadership.
Collaborate with IT, legal, compliance, privacy, and executive teams for holistic risk management.
Leverage automation and threat intelligence to enhance security operations.
Manage vendor relationships.
Coach and mentor analysts through hands-on support, including real-time incident handling, threat hunting, and query development.

What We’re Looking For

Ideally 8+ years’ experience in Information Security and/or Information Technology in an operations role
Minimum of 6 years prior experience in a role exclusively responsible for information security incident response
Prior experience managing or leading people on an information security team
Experience leading incident response in a global environment, including hands-on triage, investigation, and containment alongside the team
Willingness to participate in the 24/7/365 on-call rotation alongside the team. This is a hands-on manager position.
Experience building and maintaining SOAR playbooks.
Fluency with Splunk Processing Language [SPL], YARA-L, and Kusto Query Language [KQL]
Experience working with JIRA, ServiceNow or similar platforms
Experience working with DLP platforms
Experience creating, collecting, and assembling metrics for reporting
Experience working with hybrid (on-prem and Cloud) technology platforms and applications
Extensive experience securing and/or troubleshooting computer systems and networks
Extensive experience with Malware Assessment and Incident Response
Experience with SIEM platforms; Splunk and Microsoft Sentinel experience preferred
Experience reviewing logs, scripting tasks or creating structured queries/regex searches
Solid understanding of AI, its associated risks, and security use cases
Awareness of Information Security best practices and financial regulatory requirements
Excellent problem-solving and risk decision-making skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to communicate clearly to several levels of management while catering communication style to a wide range of technical, business, and cultural backgrounds across various business units
Ability to represent data in the most meaningful form
Ability to think and operate independently with limited guidance
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Information Security (equivalent experience may be considered)
CISSP, CISM, OSCP, CRISC, GSEC, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GFCE, GSE are preferred but not required (other advanced certifications considered)
Excellent program/project management, prioritization, and organizational skills
Acute attention to detail and solid leadership abilities, with a genuine desire to lead by example and stay close to the work

new_jobs.title: Trading Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Virtu is a leading financial firm that leverages cutting edge technology to offer liquidity to the global markets and innovative, transparent trading solutions to our clients. As a market maker, Virtu provides deep liquidity that helps to create more efficient markets around the world. Our market structure expertise, broad diversification, and execution technology enables us to provide competitive bids and offers in over 19,000 securities, at over 235 venues, in 36 countries worldwide.

THE ROLE

Our Trading Operations team is a multi-faceted group whose roles and responsibilities directly support the foundation of trading at Virtu. This team provides the operational efficiency that is central to our success in trading; they manage and optimize the logistics, mechanics and back office workflows that keep Virtu best-in-class.

We are looking to hire an Analyst who will be responsible for managing the clearance, settlement, and reconciliation of all trades and positions for the firm. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with traders, finance, compliance, brokers, custodians, and firm customers to ensure timely settlement of trades, accuracy of books and records, and avoidance of unanticipated risk to both the firm and its customers.

We look for candidates with a strong technical foundation, as you will also have the opportunity to work closely with software engineers to further automate and enhance the robustness of the firm’s operational workflows. Operations Analysts not only become experts in the logistics and mechanics of trade clearance and settlement, but they also play a crucial role in the ability of the firm to conduct trading efficiently and safely, perform challenging and stimulating data analysis, and participate in the architecture of new systems and controls.

No finance experience is necessary. We look for motivated, detail-oriented candidates with a solid technical foundation and who have a drive toward process improvement.

THE CANDIDATE

1-3 years of professional working experience. (graduates will be considered)
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field preferred (Business, Finance, Economics, and Engineering academic backgrounds preferred)
Strong experience with SQL and Python
Outstanding quantitative problem‐solving skills
The ability to communicate information precisely and with agility to parties both internal and external
A team player with a good attitude and flexibility in their time commitment to the job
Highly motivated and tenacious individual, with a proven ability to take initiative and work independently and within a team environment

THE PROCESS

After passing an application screening, candidates will be sent an online programming test via email from a service called HackerRank. This is to gain an understanding of the candidates' coding ability.

Salary Range: $125,000 - $140,000 (salary range is exclusive of bonuses, benefits or other categories of compensation)

Virtu Financial is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, welcoming you for who you are and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

new_jobs.location: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

We're looking for a high-energy, execution-focused Analyst to join our Global Patient Care team and power the operations that support 14 countries. This isn't just about monitoring queues; it's about being the engine behind a healthy Salesforce ecosystem and the pioneer of our AI-driven automation strategy. You will bridge the gap between technical infrastructure and local impact, ensuring our global operations are data-backed, automated, and running at peak performance. If you thrive in a high-visibility environment where your work ships daily and directly empowers teams worldwide, we want to talk to you.

How will you make an impact?

Salesforce & Patient Support Operations

Monitor the health of our global Salesforce case operations (routing, queues, case-reason taxonomy) and catch problems before they affect patients or local teams.
Work closely with our regional managers (LATAM & Spain, Europe) to understand each market's problems, challenges and improvement opportunities.
Turn what you find into clear, prioritized requests (problem, evidence, impact), so we can fix it ourselves or take it to the global Salesforce team. Over time, you'll handle that conversation with Salesforce directly.
Turn recurring operational issues into documented processes that work across markets while respecting each country's local needs.

AI & Automation

Track how our AI case-reply tools and automations are performing, flag regressions and suggest improvements backed by data.
Help local teams adopt the automations we build with the Salesforce team, and gather their feedback on what works and what doesn't.

Analysis & Critical Thinking

Use AI tools (Claude with our data connectors, Data Sage) and SQL to answer operational questions. What matters most is knowing which questions to ask and how to read the answers.
Identify, analyze and prioritize: turn data into a clear recommendation and defend it, and challenge ours when you think we're missing something.
Maintain our existing Superset dashboards and build simple ones when your own analysis needs them.

Qualifications

What will help you thrive?

2-5 years of experience in Operations, Strategy Ops, Sales Ops, RevOps, or Data Analysis;
Understanding of product and business dynamics;
Technical Prowess: You have working SQL skills (joins/aggregations) and can navigate Salesforce Service Cloud and Superset (or similar BI tools).
Global Communicator: Your English is sharp (written and spoken), and you can distill complex analysis into structured, persuasive business cases.
Bias to Action: You are a closer. You tackle small tasks the same day and have the grit to drive large initiatives to the finish line.
Bonus Points: You bring experience in support operations or speak Spanish, adding even more value to our multi-country coordination.

What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat
– A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview
– A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Flavia Soccol and André Mosko as your potential managers in this role .
Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣ Business Case –
A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

4️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits –
No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks –
Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth –
We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team –
Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You –
Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results –
we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner –
take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean –
smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest –
openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious –
growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

new_jobs.title: Founding Strategy and Operations Analyst role - London
new_jobs.description:
Building a More Resilient World

When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.

We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.

And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done."

We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join.

The Role

Handling claims at scale requires a strong operational foundation. As our Founding Strategy & Operations Analyst, you’ll help build the operational capability that lets ClaimSorted deliver market-leading claims handling while running efficiently as we grow. You’ll work with data to find problems, then take on the projects that fix them, increasing the speed and volume of operational change across the company. As part of this role you will:

Design and implement efficient claims processes and procedures, and make sure they are adopted and hold up as the team grows.
Build and manage the KPIs and metrics we use to handle claims and run the organisation as efficiently as possible.
Analyse operational data to understand problems, surface insights, and turn them into practical solutions.
Take ownership of small projects and support complex cross-functional initiatives, from scoping through to delivery.
Work with teams across the company to make operational changes land quickly.

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We’re a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in consulting, data or analytics, or operations at a startup, tech firm or consultancy
Demonstrated experience working with data to provide insights, understand problems and deliver effective solutions
Demonstrated experience implementing solutions and running small projects or changes
Strong written and spoken communication, with a proven ability to work cross-functionally
A generalist mindset: comfortable picking up whatever problem matters most and moving quickly
Insurance or claims experience is a plus, but not required

Our Values

Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimise for momentum.
Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.
Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.
Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for ‘good enough.’
Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

Compensation & Benefits

Generous, transparent equity participation
28 days annual leave plus bank holidays
30 days of remote work annually
Private medical insurance
Pension contributions
Company offsites
Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

About the Opportunity

Catapult Staffing Group is partnering with a leading financial technology provider that serves banks and credit unions across the country. They need two Deposit Operations specialists to help financial institutions move to new core banking systems. You’ll work alongside the client team through every phase of a conversion: design, data mapping, training, testing, and go-live. If you know how deposit operations work behind the scenes and you like being the person a bank leans on during a big change, this role is a good fit. It also comes with a clear path to a permanent position.

What You’ll Do

Support core conversions and implementations from design through post-conversion
Review conversion data and mapping for deposit/DDA products
Configure and validate deposit account parameters
Train financial institution staff on new core software
Run testing and validation, and resolve operational issues as they come up
Travel to client sites for implementation and go-live support (usually 1–2 trips a month, 6–9 days each)

Experience with one or more of these core platforms: SilverLake

Experience with testing, validation, and implementation work

$35-$40/hour (W-2)

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
We are committed to connecting Canadians through unique partnerships, our world-class network and content Canadians love—and our innovative team is growing. We are looking for dedicated team members to join our Corporate team who have a genuine passion for making positive impacts on customers and the communities where we live and work. We have a variety of business units with exciting and meaningful work waiting for you, including Communications, HR, Legal and Corporate Affairs, Supply Chain, Finance, and Real Estate. If you are considering your next step, we have exciting opportunities waiting for you. Come build a rewarding career at Rogers and be a driving force behind our success story!

An exciting opportunity exists to join as a Senior Data Analyst in the Wireless Service & Equipment Finance team. This position will be responsible for creating and maintaining Tableau dashboard that including dashboard design, creation, master data file building, data mining and measuring service & equipment revenue /usage KPIs and be able to be as story teller. Candidates will work very closely with various teams to provide value-added analysis on Wireless Revenue.

The Sr. Data Analyst will be based in Toronto and will provide expert data management to Wireless Service & Equipment Finance.

What You'll Do

Design, develop, enhance and maintain Tableau and/or Power BI dashboards supporting Wireless Service & Equipment Finance reporting and performance management.
Develop and maintain master datasets and reporting data layers using Databricks, SQL and Python, including data extraction, transformation, integration and validation from multiple data sources.
Build and automate weekly and monthly financial scorecards, dashboards and management reports, providing clear insights into performance trends and key business drivers.
Analyze large and complex datasets across multiple source systems to evaluate wireless subscriber, revenue, equipment, usage and other financial/business KPIs.
Translate business and Finance requirements into scalable data models, queries, dashboards and reporting solutions.
Write and optimize SQL queries and Databricks workflows to extract, join, cleanse, transform and aggregate large datasets for financial reporting and business analysis.
Use Python and SQL to automate recurring data preparation, validation, reconciliation and reporting processes.
Develop visually effective dashboards that enable users to understand performance, identify trends and investigate key drivers.
Perform detailed data validation and reconciliation between source systems, master datasets, financial results and reporting outputs to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Investigate data discrepancies, data quality issues and potential data corruption; identify root causes and work with appropriate teams to implement solutions.
Support Financial Analysis, Pricing, Commercial Strategy, Marketing and Sales teams by providing reliable datasets, analytical insights and ad-hoc reporting.
Process and analyze data to support business cases, forecasting, performance measurement and ad-hoc analytical requests.
Define data requirements and business rules and ensure data extracts and reporting outputs are complete, accurate and fit for purpose.
Develop and automate financial and statistical analyses using tools such as Databricks, Python, SQL, Excel, Tableau and Power BI.
Partner with Data, Technology and IT teams to identify appropriate source systems, databases and tables and understand upstream/downstream data dependencies.
Present analytical findings to Finance and business stakeholders and translate complex data into clear business stories, key insights and actionable recommendations.

What You'll Bring

3+ years’ experience in data analytics/Business Intelligence, ideally within telecommunications.
Advanced Databricks and SQL skills working with large, complex datasets.
Strong Python and/or PySpark programming and data manipulation experience.
Advanced Tableau dashboard development; Power BI experience is an asset.
Strong knowledge of data modeling, transformation, quality, architecture, and data management.
Experience building master datasets, reusable reporting sources, and automated/scalable reporting solutions.
Strong Excel skills, including large datasets and financial analysis.
Experience with statistical, trend, variance, testing, and performance analysis.
University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
Insights-driven, adaptable, collaborative, and customer-focused, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including
